title: Integers and Rationals
description: Take away more than you have and you need negative numbers; share out fairly and you need fractions. Unlocks Integer Rings and Rational Fields.

puzzle.goal: Put a/b and c/m together over the common denominator b·m. Write the top of the result, N.
puzzle.name: Adding fractions
puzzle.ask: Find N for a = 1, b = @{b}, c = 1 and m = 3.
puzzle.method: Scale each fraction to the denominator b·m: a/b = am/bm and c/m = cb/bm; then the tops add.
